title: SpatialMem: Building Quantitative Spatial Reasoning Agents with Hierarchical Memory
title_zh: SpatialMem：利用分层记忆构建定量空间推理智能体
abstract_en: Vision Language Models (VLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities in qualitative spatial reasoning, but remain limited in quantitative spatial reasoning. Current work leverages the VLM agent to invoke external vision tools to perform computation. However, these methods usually bind each functional requirement to a single predefined vision specialist, implicitly resulting in fixed and rigid tool pipelines. In practice, addressing diverse spatial scenarios and tasks demands a broader diversity in pipeline orchestration and vision specialist selection to achieve robust spatial reasoning. However, such diversity leads to a combinatorial execution space, making it challenging for the agent to orchestrate the optimal pipelines and specialists for different scenarios. In this work, we propose SpatialMem, a memory framework that enables a VLM agent to accumulate tool-use experience and leverage that memory to orchestrate vision specialists to solve the spatial reasoning problem. SpatialMem builds a two-level memory structure, with task memory capturing tool orchestration and scene memory capturing tool selection. It further introduces a dual-state trajectory optimization process to preserve successful tool experiences and refine suboptimal ones. Moreover, existing spatial reasoning benchmarks suffer from quality issues and limited coverage of scene types and tasks. To address these gap, we propose MetricBench, a benchmark covering both indoor and outdoor scenes and three quantitative spatial reasoning tasks. Our method achieves state-of-the-art results on MetricBench, Q-Spatial, and SpatilRGPT-Bench, outperforming best VLM baselines by 32% on MetricBench. Additionally, the memory design yields a 9.1% absolute gain over a memory-free agent on MetricBench.
abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）擅长定性空间推理，但在需要测量和计算的定量空间推理中仍存在局限。现有智能体通常为每类功能绑定一个预设视觉工具，导致工具调用流程僵化；引入更多候选工具又会使调用流程与工具选择的组合空间迅速扩大。SpatialMem 通过两级记忆复用工具调用经验：任务记忆记录如何编排工具流程，场景记忆记录如何针对不同场景选择工具。该框架还通过双状态轨迹优化保留成功经验，并改进次优的调用轨迹。为弥补现有基准在质量和覆盖范围上的不足，论文提出 MetricBench，涵盖室内外场景及三类定量空间推理任务。SpatialMem 在 MetricBench、Q-Spatial 和 SpatilRGPT-Bench 上取得最先进结果；在 MetricBench 上，其表现较最强 VLM 基线高 32%，较无记忆智能体高 9.1 个百分点。
key_points_zh: 固定工具流程难以适配多样的空间场景，而扩大工具候选集又会增加编排难度。
SpatialMem 将工具调用经验拆分为两级：任务记忆用于复用编排经验，场景记忆用于选择合适的视觉工具。
双状态轨迹优化保留成功的工具调用轨迹，并改进次优轨迹。
新基准 MetricBench 覆盖室内外场景和三类定量空间推理任务。
SpatialMem 在三个基准上取得最先进结果；在 MetricBench 上较最强 VLM 基线提升 32%，较无记忆智能体提升 9.1 个百分点。

agent-multimodal.reason: 视觉工具使用经验是智能体记忆的核心：任务记忆指导工具编排，场景记忆指导工具选择，替代固定工具流水线。相较无记忆智能体，MetricBench 得分绝对提升 9.1%，但摘要未分别验证两层记忆的作用。
